condition_definition: v2 of the matched Yoruba data adaptation: identical to the original Condition B recipe (same checkpoint, recordings, split, budget, seed) except the stochastic duration predictor is frozen at its pretrained state during fine-tuning. Diagnostic (duration_diagnostic/, checked directly by listening) showed skipped syllables in v1's output persisted regardless of decoding-time duration-sampling noise, meaning the duration predictor's learned mean prediction (not sampling variance) drifted during fine-tuning on very few examples for some sounds. This freezes it at the known-reliable Condition A state and lets only the rest of the network (text encoder embeddings aside, flow, posterior encoder, waveform decoder) adapt toward the target voice.

implementation.implementation_policy: Record resolved commit IDs and source-tree SHA-256 before execution
implementation.required_entrypoint: original VITS train.py with only the frozen single-GPU, accumulation, development-evaluation, early-stopping, provenance, and duration-predictor-freeze patches

initialization.reason_optimizer_reset: avoid inherited optimizer moments dominating the 23-clip adaptation run

data.audio_normalization: original PCM scale only; no loudness normalization, trimming, denoising, or augmentation
data.text: authoritative NFC Yoruba; MMS vocabulary filtering and blank insertion only

trainable_modules.generator: text encoder, flow, posterior encoder, and waveform decoder

checkpoint_selection.selection_metric: mean development reconstruction objective: 45*mel_L1 + duration_nll + KL

randomness.scope: feasibility pilot; multi-seed replication required for confirmatory claims

overfitting_safeguards: low 1e-5 learning rate from the full pretrained checkpoint
early stopping after four non-improving evaluations, but not before update 100
restore the best development checkpoint rather than the last checkpoint
no test-set access for selection or stopping
no oversampling, augmentation, auxiliary labels, or loss-weight tuning beyond the duration-predictor freeze
log train-development loss gap and flag a gap larger than 25 percent
duration predictor frozen at the known-reliable Condition A state; cannot regress from fine-tuning on sparse data

compute.estimated_wall_time: approximately 30 to 120 minutes for the 300-update cap after setup; benchmark the first 10 updates and report the measured estimate

approval_gate: Do not download the full training archive, prepare a GPU runtime, update weights, or inspect test outputs until this exact recipe is approved.
